card.name: Linking words before dose changes
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "after", "following", "or" and "of" that come right before a change event, like a dose increase, dose reduction, initiation or discontinuation, in label monitoring instructions.

modes.label: after/following a dose change
modes.description: "after" or "following" introduces a dose increase, reduction or adjustment as a time point for monitoring.
modes.example: especially within the first 24-72 hours of initiating therapy and<< following>> dosage increases with belladonna and op

modes.label: after a period or condition
modes.description: "after" links a lab threshold or persistent finding to a time span or treatment step.
modes.example: utropenia If absolute neutrophil count decreases (ANC less than 1.0 × 10 9 /L) and remains low<< after>> 72 hours, temporarily interrupt TA

modes.label: other linking words
modes.description: "of" or "or" before an event or effect noun in general or label text.
modes.example: This may be due to the effects<< of>> early generations of massive stars that exploded as

card.writes: It seems to favor words for restarting or rebuilding and to suppress words about adjusting or stability.
card.plain: It fires on little words like "after" and "following" that lead into a dose change or start of treatment.
